newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HOIU WANTS HALF OF RETAIL BANK MARKET.
newsitem.headline: HOIU WANTS HALF OF RETAIL BANK MARKET.

text.p: Estonia's second largest bank, Hoiupank, is aiming to capture some 50 percent of the market for retail banking compared to its present 44 percent.
"We want to gain about 50 percent of the private persons market in a long-term perspective," vice-chairman Priit Haller told Reuters at the annual shareholder meeting on Saturday.
Hoiupank also wants to increase its market share in corporate banking from its present nine to 12 percent to 18 percent, Haller added.
Hoiupank plans to expand geographically this year, and its priority is Lithuania, Haller added.
Hoiupank has said earlier it wants to enter the Lithuanian market through its subsidiaries.
The bank also wants to insurance activities in St Petersburg and real estate operations in Estonia, board member Aare Kilp also said.
